mathematical_kernel.field_model: Endpoint A, endpoint B, and selected center C remain in independent isolated univariate fields. Projective denominators are normalized positive before signs are interpreted geometrically.
mathematical_kernel.line_elimination: For d = B-A and v = A-C, the infinite-line parameter is s = bw*(-vd +/- sqrt(K))/(cw*d2), with d2 = dot(d,d), vd = dot(v,d), v2r = dot(v,v)-r^2*(aw*cw)^2, and K = vd^2-d2*v2r after homogeneous denominator clearing.
mathematical_kernel.branch_filters: Each radical branch is filtered exactly by the selected semicircle half, diameter boundary, q = -vd +/- sqrt(K), bw*q-cw*d2 finite-segment predicates, duplicate endpoint ownership, and traversal orientation.
mathematical_kernel.radical_sign: A trivariate rational-plus-square-root expression signs rational and radical terms first and squares only when their signs require comparison; the selected-root refinement graph remains authoritative.
mathematical_kernel.tensor_correctness_fix: Trivariate coefficient tensors are rectangularized before restriction and trim only whole zero planes, rows, or columns. Per-row trimming was invalid for the rectangular restriction algorithm.

benchmark_method.perf_method: taskset CPU 11; perf stat user-space instructions, cycles, branches, branch misses, and cache misses; 64 fixed timed iterations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract the implementation-filter=disabled process and divide by 65
benchmark_method.heap_method: Heaptrack record-only; 32 fixed timed iterations plus one Runner warm-up; subtract the implementation-filter=disabled process and divide allocation counters by 33; peak is the exact maximum mem_heap_B from Heaptrack Massif export
benchmark_method.linked_size_method: GNU size and stat on matched comparative release executables with identical benchmark source and dependency revisions
benchmark_method.profile_method: perf cycles:u sampling of the current end-to-end executable; flat percentages are directional hotspot evidence rather than deterministic counters

wall_performance.interpretation: Current produces complete exact geometry. Historical and Cavalier ratios are not equivalent-algorithm regressions; the former stops at uncertainty and the latter has materially weaker numeric and topology guarantees.

runtime_profile.flat_cycle_observation: The largest named samples are libc comparison/allocation/free plus Hyperreal small-rational normalization: memcmp 4.34%, _int_malloc 4.16%, malloc 3.54%, Rational::gcd_word 3.31%, free 3.26%, from_reduced_word_parts 2.63%, and quotient_ring_resultant_polynomial 1.66%.
